title: copilot-proxy-rs: right default for COPILOT_MAX_RATE (decision models need bursts)
prompt:
copilot-proxy-rs limits all upstream Copilot requests with one shared token bucket: `copilot_max_rate` (env COPILOT_MAX_RATE, config.json key copilot_max_rate), default 15 per minute (src/config.rs, TokenBucket in src/copilot/client.rs). The decision models added in #60 (gpt-6-luna-decisions -> /v1/decisions, microsoft-decision-1 -> /v1/systemone) send one upstream request per question, and a client such as the software factory asks 4-20 questions at once. Measured on the live proxy (owner data, do not re-measure on 8080):
- At 15/min every request after the first waits ~3.7 s (log: `copilot request rate limited wait.seconds=3.7`); a 232-question benchmark had p50 8-20 s and 25-146 of 232 requests time out at 60 s. The upstream call itself took 0.19-0.74 s (elapsed.ms).
- With copilot_max_rate=120 in config.json: 40 parallel decision questions per model all returned 200 in 2.7-3.6 s wall time, no rate-limit waits, no upstream 429.

Goal: pick the right default and ship it, or recommend a better design if a single global default is wrong. Steps:
1. Research first: why 15 was chosen (git log -S copilot_max_rate, README, docs, comments); what Copilot's upstream limits are and how the proxy reacts to an upstream 429 (retry, Retry-After, copilot_retry_max); whether chat, decisions and image requests should share one bucket. Record findings with sources in the PR body.
2. Decide and implement the smallest change that fixes bursts of decision questions without risking upstream 429s for chat traffic. Options to weigh (choose one, explain why the others lose): (a) raise the global default (e.g. 120); (b) a separate higher limit for the decisions family; (c) also allow 0 to mean unlimited if not already. Keep the env var and config key working and backward compatible; document the default and the key in README.
3. Tests: unit tests for the chosen limiter behavior and config parsing; cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked pass with no Cargo.lock change.
4. Proof: build this branch and run it on port 18080 (COPILOT_PROXY_RS_PORT=18080, COPILOT_PROXY_RS_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.config/copilot-proxy-rs so it reads the existing config and token in place; never copy a token or config file, the shell refuses it). Note: that config.json now sets copilot_max_rate=120, so do not use a temp config dir (it has no token); instead set COPILOT_MAX_RATE explicitly per run to show old (15) vs new default behavior. Send 40 parallel decision questions (20 to each decision model) through /v1/chat/completions and show wall time, status codes and the count of `rate limited` log lines for both settings, in the PR body under "Proof".
5. PR body: a section "Recommendation" with the chosen default, the reason, the risk, and what the owner should set in config.json if they want a different value.
- Never touch, stop or bind the live proxy on 8080. Keep COPILOT_PROXY_RS_LOG_FAILED_REQUEST_BODIES behavior unchanged. Do not log tokens, prompts or bodies.
- This is a repeatable factory test: other open PRs for related work are earlier runs. Ignore them and build a new PR.
